checks: One player waits in queue; server never invents a partner
Duplicate join does not duplicate queue membership
FIFO auto-pair assigns distinct authoritative slots
When room capacity is full, players stay in queue instead of failing
Client can control only assigned player: injected score, lives and coordinates ignored
Out-of-order input sequence cannot overwrite newer controls
Missing input automatically neutralizes held movement/fire
Reconnect bearer token restores the same player and room during grace
Disconnect timeout ends old room and immediately pairs waiting players
Explicit leave notifies partner; no forced auto-requeue
Malformed JSON is contained and connection is closed
Oversized packets rejected by WebSocket maxPayload
limitations: Local test. Guest session tokens are reconnect credentials, NOT verified VK Play identities. No production DDoS, load or moderation test.
